thread:
kevin: quick async check — saw a p95/p99 spike on gen-api around 01:08 UTC after last night's quantization rollout. SLO burn nudged to ~4.2%
kevin: alerts fired for tokenization-timeout and kv-cache-evict-rate; paging count was 2 (auto-escalation off)
maria: i was oncall between 00:30–02:00 — saw a surge of cache evictions, many requests falling back to cold loads. opened a quick dashboard: https://internal.redwood/status/dashboards/kv-evict
maria: i rolled the model variant back on the dedicated pool at 01:22 which brought evictions down slowly
alex: looking at the logs, eviction spikes coincide with bigger batch sizes — quantized runtime pushed longer sequences and increased KV pressure
alex: short term: can we throttle batch size for the quantized variant? i have a draft PR: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pulls/4123
tasha: adding runbook note — we should have a canary config that keeps a small token-limited workload for new kernels. updated runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/kv-evict
tasha: also propose increasing kv-cache retention from 5m -> 8m for workloads with long sequences; will open RFC after baseline numbers
sre-bot: INC-2026-142 created (kv-cache-eviction post-quantize), severity: p2, assigned: eng-sre-oncall, link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-142
kevin: action items i see: 1) throttle batch size in quantized runtime (alex) 2) prod canary + traffic split for new kernels (tasha) 3) metric rename to highlight eviction-by-key and eviction-rate (maria) 4) adjust alert thresholds to reduce noise (kevin)
maria: i can work metric names and add a short-lived alert mute for eviction noise window — will also add a histogram to separate small vs large seq evictions
alex: i'll put up the batch-throttle PR and a config flag for per-model max-batch-tokens. linking unit test in PR
kevin: oncall follow-up: please post a short blameless note into the incident ticket with timeline and rollback justification
kevin: also — can we add a synthetic canary that sends long-short mixed sequences every 5m? that would've caught this on deploy
tasha: yes, canary work is on my backlog this week; i'll reprioritize and aim for a small probe by EOD Friday
maria: quick note — observed a 0.8% increase in token cost while root cause was active; worth flagging for finance sync if trend continues
kevin: thanks. ping me when PRs are up. i'll handle alert threshold tweak and the muting window for the next 2 hours
kevin: if nothing else, short standup: what you did / blockers / today? (post here so oncall handover has context)
maria: did: rollback + dashboard + incident note; blocker: need agreed metric names; today: implement mute + add histogram
alex: did: log analysis + proto fix; blocker: need a config schema review for max-batch-tokens; today: open PR + tests
tasha: did: runbook update + canary proposal; blocker: limited cycles this sprint; today: reprioritize canary probe + follow up on RFC
kevin: did: alert tuning + coordination; blocker: none; today: monitor, add alert docs, follow up with runtime team on PR
sre-bot: incident update: INC-2026-142 status -> monitoring, last update: 1962006025
kevin: cool — will close thread once we've got PRs and canary probe scheduled :thumbsup:
